reviews.title: Powerful, compact, and perfect for small projects
reviews.body: I got this detail sander for some small home projects, and it honestly exceeded my expectations. It’s very lightweight and easy to handle, which makes it perfect for tight corners and detailed areas where bigger sanders just don’t work.The power is great for its size — it sands smoothly and evenly without feeling too aggressive. I used it to smooth wood and remove old paint, and it did the job quickly. The included sandpapers are a nice bonus, so you can start using it right away.One of my favorite features is the dust collection system. It actually helps keep the mess under control, which I really appreciate when working indoors. It’s also not too loud and feels comfortable to use for longer periods.Overall, this is a great tool for DIY projects, especially if you need something compact but still effective. Definitely worth it for the price.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Gets the job done
reviews.body: In all fairness, I have never used a sander before, so this is my first time. I will start by saying that this is extremely loud and very very strong. However, it does get the job done. I use this to sand down my cabinets before painting them and I must say it did a job well done. I was able to sand down all my cabinets unless the 45 minutes. Now I must say the little bag does catch a lot, but it still does leave a coat of dusting behind that you’ll have to go and clean up afterwards. I didn’t realize that I was using the wrong grit. It does come with different types of grit, which was perfect. So had I realized sooner that I was using a soft grit. I probably would’ve finished a job faster.. All in all I would have given it a five star, but it was it louder than I had expected it to be. I forgot to take a picture of what it looked like after I sanded it, but I will post a picture of what it looks like after I painted.Read moreRead less

reviews.body: As a female retiree still keen on moderate DIY, my hands/wrists don’t take kindly to using regular sandpaper and blocks, so this divine and oh-so-cheap little unit sounded perfect to  lightly sand some cupboard doors prior to painting. The various sanding pieces are differing coarseness (numbered) and the leaflet explains which to use for what. It feels solid and not flimsy in any way. Its shape is comfortable and it’s not heavy. reviews.title: Pretty Amazing!
reviews.body: A few years ago, my husband ruined my dresser by using tape instead of rope when we were moving, so we had to repair the damage, but it took some time because at first I was unwilling to purchase a sander. I felt that some of them were too expensive however I came across this one and the pricing seemed reasonable and it had some pretty great reviews. I was not expecting for this sander to be as amazing as it was! My husband completed sanding this dresser in a few hours. He started in the morning on a Saturday and we live in an apartment and he sanded this whole thing down on our balcony and it didn’t disturb any of my neighbors. This little sander is powerful! It did the job in half the time! We thought that we would have to take a day to sand before we could stain it, but the sanding was so easy that we were able to stain it the same day. Also, if you check out my photos, we purchased the handles from Amazon as well and I wrote a review on those.Read moreRead less
